svg.title: Heddle woven HD icon, black and white
svg.desc: Black H and D on a transparent background with 16-unit separation cuts and subtle 2-unit cut-edge corner radii. The D has a centered horizontal cut.
svg.metadata: Color: black #000000. Background and cuts: transparent. D outer radius: 152; inner radius: 80; center: (312,216). H vertical stroke width: 80; horizontal stroke width: 64 (y=184..248). D ribbon width: 72 away from the local 2-unit terminal and cut-edge fillets. All separation corridors remain fully transparent and at least 16 units wide. Center cut: y=208..224. H external corner radius: 20; internal corner radius: 2. D cut fillets are tangent to the unchanged outer and inner circles. D inner bottom: y=296, aligned to the lower edge of the shared H cut. H-to-D separation: x=280..296. Crossbar-to-stem separation: x=184..200. Bottom pieces are exact reflections about y=216 (viewBox y=280). Canvas: 480 by 480, centered on the visible HD bounds without scaling the geometry. Coordinates above precede the common 64-unit vertical translation.
